tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH counts AS (
  SELECT a.ArtistId, ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS album_count
  FROM Album a
  JOIN Artist ar USING(ArtistId)
  GROUP BY a.ArtistId
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY album_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM counts
)
SELECT ArtistId, Name, album_count, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY album_count DESC, Name
;"}
